profile.headline: Software Engineer at Microsoft
profile.summary:
I’m a tenacious, creative IT professional whose curiosity and passion for problem solving led me to a career in software development. Since my earliest career days as an electronic systems technician for the U.S. Air Force, I’ve had a knack for spotting opportunities to streamline, optimize and improve systems and business processes. 

I’m, perhaps, at my best when finding ways to apply technology to those “it can’t be done” challenges within an organization – and then setting about a plan to build  tools that will prove that yes, in fact, it can be.

I enjoy talking tech and welcome you to contact me at seanmiller168@gmail.com.

positions.title: IoT Developer
positions.description:
- Worked on back-end MQTT services in Python on Linux and Raspberry Pi.
- Added features in client mobile app using React.
- Developed embedded services with ESP32 and ESP8266 using C++.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Assists Test Development Engineer in writing automated tests for electronic hardware. General debugging, maintenance, and feature improvements such as the user interface Utilizing C#, .NET, and WPF on desktop clients.

positions.title: Jr. Software Developer
positions.description:
I joined this privately-held consultancy as a business development manager, supporting the sales team in pursuing new opportunities. I began taking on programming / development assignments with the objective of improving and streamlining sales proposal processes. The work so inspired me that I transitioned into a full-time software developer role, with focus on concept-through-launch development of new web applications, mobile designs and tools targeted to improve ease-of-use and productivity for the sales team. 

✔ Developed a standalone web interface for improving the RFP process utilizing Django/Postgres, to automate bid processes.

✔ Designed and implemented multiple systems that have improved functionality and code quality, and streamlined the company’s process for moving from the bidding process to development stage.

✔ Successfully juggling the demands of a full-time career with requirements of computer science degree program.

positions.title: Business Development Manager
positions.description:
•	Identified and pursued new partnership opportunities that drove client acquisition. Grew top of the funnel user acquisition channels.
•	Managed and measured partnerships from concept-to-launch to determine ROI.
•	Delivered on new business development goals comprised of direct sales, partner management and implementation of marketing activities.
•	Managed programming projects to improve day to day operational efficiency. Automated projects using Python, PhantomJS and Selenium. 
•	Deployed a stand-alone web interface using Django/Mezzanine with a MySQL backend to serve as a database for the RFP (request for proposal) questions and answers; eliminated the need to continually create new content for each RFP.
•	Negotiated and implemented contracts; collaborated on joint bids for projects and negotiated pricing.
•	As subject matter expert, utilized deep technical understanding of advanced technology and employee engagement initiatives to facilitate achievement of organizational goals.

positions.title: Microbiology Instructional Aide II
positions.description: I leveraged my science and mathematics background to mentor and support microbiology students. Here, I worked in the lab preparing culture media and supplies, and ensuring equipment was properly maintained.

positions.title: Customer Service Representative
positions.description:
While studying for my bachelor’s degree, I worked for the DoD's commissary system. I assisted customers, maintained proper inventory levels, reconciled invoices and submitted requisitions. 

✔ Collected inventory data to maintain the Computer Assisted Ordering (CAO) system.
